title: こたつとみかんの冬
subject_en: Cozy winter home scenes in a loose hand-drawn style: kotatsu table, mandarin oranges, blankets; people with simple faces, each a small complete scene Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: こたつ・みかん・毛布・湯たんぽなど、家で過ごす冬の場面12点の素材です。冬のお知らせやブログの挿し絵に使えます。
items: a person with a blanket sitting at a kotatsu table
a person peeling a mandarin orange at a table
a basket piled with mandarin oranges
a person lying asleep with legs under a kotatsu
a cat curled up on a kotatsu blanket
a hot cup of tea with steam on a tray
a hot water bottle with a knitted cover
a person wrapped in a thick blanket on a sofa
an old round kerosene heater with a kettle on top
a pair of thick striped socks
a fogged-up window with snow falling outside
a family of three sitting together in front of a television
